description: M4 Deduplication (tasks.md T4.1-T4.4, FR-12-FR-15, E-1, E-10, E-13, AC-4). Add deterministic similarity scoring with date blocking, merge logic that builds one Event linking all contributing SourceRecords (flagging borderline as possible_duplicate), and a stable dedup_key for idempotent upsert. Depends on FEAT-003 (normalized records) and uses config.dedup thresholds.
steps: Create vandy_food_radar/dedup/__init__.py and vandy_food_radar/dedup/similarity.py: pure functions title_sim (lowercase, strip punctuation, remove stopwords, token Jaccard so 'Free Pizza Night' ~ 'Pizza Night (Free!)'), time_proximity (1.0 within config.dedup.time_proximity_minutes decaying to 0), location_sim, organizer_sim, and a combined weighted similarity. Add a blocking helper that groups records by event_date so recurring occurrences on different days are never compared (E-10).

Create vandy_food_radar/dedup/deduplicator.py: within each date block, cluster records; >= config.dedup.merge_threshold merge as same event; [review_low, merge_threshold) merge AND set possible_duplicate; < review_low keep separate. Merge builds one Event referencing all contributing SourceRecords (canonical field choice deferred to verify). Generate a deterministic dedup_key = event_date + stable fingerprint (sorted normalized title tokens + normalized venue + rounded start time).

Create tests/test_dedup.py: the two pizza-night fixtures merge into exactly one event linked to both source records (AC-4); two different events at the same time do NOT merge (E-13); the same recurring title on two different dates does NOT merge (E-10); dedup_key is identical across repeated runs on the same inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Similarity is deterministic, combines title/time/location/organizer, and blocks by event_date (T4.1, FR-13, E-10).
Duplicates merge into one Event linking every contributing SourceRecord; borderline flagged possible_duplicate (T4.2, FR-12/14/15).
dedup_key is deterministic and stable across runs, enabling idempotent upsert (T4.3, FR-42).
The two pizza-night sources merge to one event; same-time-different and recurring-across-days do not merge (T4.4, AC-4, E-13, E-10).
uv run pytest tests/test_dedup.py passes and `make check` is green.
findings:
Implemented in vandy_food_radar/dedup/ (similarity.py, deduplicator.py, __init__.py). All pure/deterministic, no I/O. Import surface: `from vandy_food_radar.dedup import deduplicate, MergedEvent, compute_dedup_key, combined_similarity, title_sim, time_proximity, location_sim, organizer_sim, title_tokens, block_by_date, FINGERPRINT_TIME_ROUNDING_MINUTES`.

SIMILARITY (similarity.py): all Jaccard-based, whole-set token overlap on lowercased/punctuation-stripped/whitespace-collapsed text.
- title_tokens(title): tokens minus TITLE_STOPWORDS (a,an,and,at,for,free,in,of,on,the,to,with). 'Free Pizza Night' & 'Pizza Night (Free!)' -> {night,pizza} -> title_sim==1.0.
- title_sim/location_sim/organizer_sim: Jaccard of token sets; empty-vs-anything => 0.0 (no signal, never negative). location/organizer use ALL tokens (no stopword removal).
- time_proximity(l,r,window_minutes): compares wall-clock minutes-since-midnight (tzinfo IGNORED); 1.0 at 0 delta, linear decay to 0.0 at >=window, 0.0 if either time is None. window<=0 => exact-match only.
- combined_similarity(l,r,config): weighted sum with WEIGHTS title 0.45 + time 0.25 + location 0.20 + organizer 0.10 (sum 1.0). time uses config.time_proximity_minutes.
- block_by_date(records) -> dict[date|None, list]: groups by event_date preserving input order; unparseable-date records share the None block and only compare among themselves (E-10).

DEDUP_KEY FINGERPRINT RECIPE (compute_dedup_key, design.md §4 step 5): '{day}|{title_fp}|{venue_fp}|{time_fp}' where day = event_date.isoformat() or 'no-date'; title_fp = space-joined SORTED title_tokens (stopword-filtered); venue_fp = space-joined SORTED title_tokens(location) (same tokenizer, so venue is also stopword-filtered); time_fp = start time rounded to nearest FINGERPRINT_TIME_ROUNDING_MINUTES (=30) as zero-padded 'HHMM' (mod 24h), or 'none'. Deterministic & order-independent -> stable across runs for idempotent upsert (FR-42). Reworded titles + equivalent venue + near start time share one key.

DEDUPLICATOR (deduplicate(records, *, config) -> list[MergedEvent]): blocks by date (sorted ascending, undated None block emitted LAST), then greedy single-link clustering within each block: a record joins the existing cluster with the highest best-member similarity that is >= config.review_low (0.55); if that best score is < config.merge_threshold (0.75) the cluster is flagged possible_duplicate; below review_low it seeds a new cluster. Records processed in given (stable) order for determinism.

MERGED-EVENT STRUCTURE (MergedEvent dataclass): fields dedup_key:str, members:list[NormalizedRecord] (EVERY contributing source record — this is the authoritative link list; join back to SourceRecord via member.source_record_id), possible_duplicate:bool, and event:Event (built in __post_init__). The Event shell is PROVISIONAL/placeholder only — canonical per-field selection is DEFERRED to verify (FEAT-005). Shell fields come from a deterministic representative member (_canonical_member = max by (title-token count, source_record_id)); event.id and event.dedup_key both == dedup_key; event.event_date = first member with a parseable date, else date(1970,1,1) fallback to satisfy the non-null Event.event_date contract (verify/ranking must overwrite, not trust, these placeholders). food_confirmed/food_category/etc. on the shell are just the representative's values.

VERIFIED BEHAVIOR: two pizza-night fixtures merge to ONE MergedEvent with 2 members {anchor_link, google_calendar}, possible_duplicate False (score ~0.86). Same-time-different (Salsa vs Chess, both 18:00 same day) stay 2 events. Recurring 'Weekly Free Coffee Hour' on 2025-03-11 vs 2025-03-18 stay 2 events (date blocking). dedup_key stable across reordered inputs. tests/test_dedup.py (11 tests) green; full make check green (71 tests, ruff+black+mypy --strict clean).
